requirement.description: The Layout.const() method has incorrect error handling for non-mapping/sequence inputs. When a non-mapping/sequence is passed, it raises a TypeError with an unclear message instead of the expected assertion error for the specific test case.
requirement.contract: The Layout.const() method should validate that the input is either a mapping or a sequence, and raise a TypeError with the message "Layout constant initializer must be a mapping or a sequence, not <type>" when it's neither.

requirement.description: The View.__getitem__ method incorrectly raises a TypeError when trying to index a non-ArrayLayout with a value. It should allow indexing with values for array layouts only.
requirement.contract: The View.__getitem__ method should raise a TypeError with message "Only views with array layout, not StructLayout({}), may be indexed with a value" when attempting to index a non-array layout with a value.

requirement.description: The View.__getitem__ method doesn't properly validate that the key is a value when indexing an ArrayLayout. It should only allow indexing with values for ArrayLayout.
requirement.contract: The View.__getitem__ method should validate that when indexing an ArrayLayout, the key must be a value or a value-castable object.

requirement.description: The View.__getattr__ method provides incorrect error messages for missing fields. It should provide more accurate suggestions based on the actual field names.
requirement.contract: The View.__getattr__ method should provide error messages with accurate field name suggestions when accessing a non-existent field.

requirement.description: The View.__getattr__ method doesn't properly handle reserved field names when accessed via attribute access. It should raise an AttributeError with a specific message.
requirement.contract: The View.__getattr__ method should raise an AttributeError with message "View of <target> field '<name>' has a reserved name and may only be accessed by indexing" when a reserved field name is accessed via attribute access.
